objective: Use bounded Replay Two episodes to verify whether one candidate changes the intended entry, stop, target, exit and resulting trade behavior under a predeclared market condition; require independent evidence of positive net profit after costs before Paper review.

stages.name: AS_BUILT_DIAGNOSTIC
stages.allowed_claim: As-built execution and telemetry parity only

stages.name: DISCOVERY_BEHAVIOR_EXPERIMENT
stages.selection: Freeze a selector using only pre-event inputs, enumerate every matching qualified discovery episode and declared positive/negative controls, then compare the exact baseline and one-mechanism candidate in bounded Replay Two segments.
stages.allowed_claim: Mechanism development and candidate rejection or freeze, never independent confirmation

stages.name: INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION
stages.selection: Use every predeclared eligible window and contract without narrowing after results are seen; preserve spent-role rules.
stages.allowed_claim: Governed verdict on the frozen candidate only; no redesign or threshold selection

acceptance.behavior: The candidate must exhibit the declared behavior on the targeted cases without altering unrelated VWAP rules; report every matching case and counterexample.
acceptance.profit: The frozen candidate must show positive net profit after realistic costs with controlled drawdown and no single-trade dependence on independent predeclared evidence. A smaller loss does not pass.
acceptance.scope: Targeted episodes test the mechanism; they do not replace the independent profitability verdict or a human Paper decision. No arbitrary multi-month replay is required solely to reproduce a mechanism.
